_说明: 这一集自己的角色，参考图 refs/<id>.png 由 char_* 挑好后拷过去，图片不进仓库。小鸭子只是背景，不单独做角色。

tadpole.desc: a tiny round black tadpole like a little ink drop, with a round head, big round shiny white eyes with black pupils and highlights, rosy cheeks, a tiny smile and a thin wiggly black tail
tadpole.keep: big ROUND white eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-drop black body

frogmom.desc: a big gentle mother frog with bright jade-green skin, a soft cream-white belly, big round golden eyes with white highlights, a wide warm smile and a small pink lotus petal tucked behind one eye
frogmom.keep: pink lotus petal by one eye, jade green with cream belly, big ROUND golden eyes

duck.desc: a plump white mother duck with an orange beak and feet, round black eyes and a tiny blue scarf

goldfish.desc: a round red-and-white goldfish with huge round bulging googly eyes, a flowing veil tail and a little round O-shaped mouth

turtle.desc: an old slow sea-green pond turtle with a round shell, four chubby flipper legs, round sleepy kind eyes and a tiny white beard tuft
turtle.keep: tiny white beard tuft, four chubby legs
